## Press Release


## Braemar Hotels & Resorts Files Definitive Proxy Statement and Mails Letter to Stockholders


Company Release - 11/20/2026


*Highlights Positive Momentum Going Into Next Chapter as a Self-Managed REIT*


*Appoints Seven New Independent Directors Following Resignation of Legacy Board; New Directors and CEO Richard Stockton Will Stand for Election at the Annual Meeting*


*Urges Stockholders to Vote the GOLD Proxy Card FOR Braemar’s Eight Highly Qualified Director Nominees*


DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) (“Braemar” or the “Company”) today announced that it has filed its definitive proxy statement (the “Definitive Proxy Statement”) with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) in connection with its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the “Annual Meeting”), scheduled for December 21, 2026. The Company also announced that seven new independent directors have been appointed to the Board of Directors (the “Board”). Together with Braemar’s President & Chief Executive Officer Richard J. Stockton, who continues to serve on the Board, they comprise the Company’s eight highly qualified director nominees, all of whom will stand for election at the Annual Meeting.


In addition, the Company has mailed a letter to stockholders highlighting its completed transition to a self-managed REIT and the growth opportunities across its luxury portfolio, and providing an overview of its director nominees, who are well positioned to lead Braemar forward.


The full text of the letter is available[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fbraemarhotelsandresorts.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com%2FBraemar%2BLetter%2Bto%2BStockholders%2B%2528November%2B20%2B2026%2529.pdf&esheet=54644786&newsitemid=20261120067345&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=1c97a91dea32409b3ca1f105e104159d) .


“We are proud of the progress Braemar has made this year and excited about the opportunities ahead,” said Mr. Stockton. “On behalf of the entire Company, I want to thank our outgoing directors for guiding Braemar through this transition. As a self-managed REIT, our high-quality luxury portfolio continues to perform well, and we believe Braemar is well positioned to deliver long-term value for stockholders. Our new directors have the experience and expertise to oversee the Company’s next chapter, and we encourage all stockholders to vote the GOLD proxy card FOR each of them at our upcoming Annual Meeting.”


For more information, stockholders are encouraged to visit:[www.BHRproxyvote2026.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.BHRproxyvote2026.com&esheet=54644786&newsitemid=20261120067345&lan=en-US&anchor=www.BHRproxyvote2026.com&index=2&md5=f7ef5d1ca2543362d6253f42ff936861) .


**PROTECT YOUR INVESTMENT. VOTE THE GOLD PROXY CARD TODAY.**


If you have any questions or require any assistance in voting your GOLD proxy card, please contact:


Innisfree M&A Incorporated
500 Fifth Avenue, 21st Floor
New York, NY 10110
Stockholders may call toll-free: (877) 750-0870
Banks and brokers may call collect: (212) 750-5833


**About Braemar Hotels & Resorts**


Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: BHR) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on the luxury hotel and resort sector. The Company targets luxury urban and resort properties. Its portfolio features luxury properties across the United States and the U.S. territories in the Caribbean.

**Important Information for Investors and Stockholders**


**Certain Information Regarding Participants**


Braemar, its directors and certain of its executive officers, and the other persons identified as participants in the Definitive Proxy Statement, are, or may be deemed to be, “participants” (as defined in Schedule 14A under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended) in the solicitation of proxies from the Company’s stockholders in connection with the matters to be considered at the annual meeting of stockholders expected to be held on December 21, 2026 (the “2026 Annual Meeting”). Information regarding the participants and their respective direct and indirect interests in Braemar, by security holdings or otherwise, is set forth in the Definitive Proxy Statement, which the Company filed with the SEC on November 20, 2026, which is available[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2Fix%3Fdoc%3D%2FArchives%2Fedgar%2Fdata%2F0001574085%2F000157408526000189%2Fbhr-20261120.htm&esheet=54644786&newsitemid=20261120067345&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=3&md5=392dc08ec3334b55da4637476126498f) , including under the headings “SUMMARY”, “PROPOSAL NUMBER ONE-ELECTION OF DIRECTORS”, “CORPORATE GOVERNANCE”, “BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND COMMITTEES”, “EXECUTIVE OFFICERS”, “EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION”, “PROPOSAL NUMBER TWO-ADVISORY APPROVAL OF EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION”, “PROPOSAL NUMBER FOUR-APPROVAL OF THE 2026 PERFORMANCE INCENTIVE PLAN”, “PROPOSAL NUMBER FIVE-APPROVAL OF THE FOLLOWING PROPOSALS TO AMEND OUR EXISTING CHARTER”, “SECURITY OWNERSHIP OF MANAGEMENT AND CERTAIN BENEFICIAL OWNERS”, “CERTAIN RELATIONSHIPS AND RELATED PERSON TRANSACTIONS”, and “ANNEX B ADDITIONAL INFORMATION REGARDING PARTICIPANTS IN THE SOLICITATION”. Additional information can also be found in the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed with the SEC on March 12, 2026 (available[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2Fix%3Fdoc%3D%2FArchives%2Fedgar%2Fdata%2F1574085%2F000157408526000038%2Fbhr-20251231.htm&esheet=54644786&newsitemid=20261120067345&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=4&md5=11ebc474ebdb62bea169efbaee67ab7a) ), as amended by the Amendment No. 1 to the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (available[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2Fix%3Fdoc%3D%2FArchives%2Fedgar%2Fdata%2F1574085%2F000157408526000063%2Fbhr-20251231.htm&esheet=54644786&newsitemid=20261120067345&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=5&md5=dc12eca3ce04228c3e818a161ed0fc96) ). These documents, including any amendments or supplements thereto, and other documents filed by the Company with the SEC, are or will be available free of charge at the SEC’s website at[www.sec.gov](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov&esheet=54644786&newsitemid=20261120067345&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sec.gov&index=6&md5=4ba199c88c952c5884aa593e1e16babf) . **Important Information and Where to Find It**


Braemar has filed the Definitive Proxy Statement and GOLD proxy card with the SEC in connection with its solicitation of proxies from the Company’s stockholders for the 2026 Annual Meeting. The Definitive Proxy Statement was filed with the SEC on November 20, 2026. This communication is not a substitute for the Definitive Proxy Statement or any other document filed by Braemar with the SEC in connection with the solicitation. BRAEMAR STOCKHOLDERS ARE URGED TO READ THE DEFINITIVE PROXY STATEMENT (INCLUDING ANY AMENDMENTS OR SUPPLEMENTS THERETO) AND ANY OTHER RELEVANT DOCUMENTS FILED BY BRAEMAR WITH THE SEC CAREFULLY AND IN THEIR ENTIRETY BECAUSE THEY CONTAIN IMPORTANT INFORMATION. Stockholders may obtain copies of these documents and other documents filed with the SEC by Braemar free of charge at[www.sec.gov](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov&esheet=54644786&newsitemid=20261120067345&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sec.gov&index=8&md5=d07a0c428a064fc421bb39d5cabaeb61) or by accessing the “SEC Filings” section of the Company’s website at[www.braemar.q4ir.com/investor/financials-sec-filings/sec-filings/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.braemar.q4ir.com%2Finvestor%2Ffinancials-sec-filings%2Fsec-filings%2F&esheet=54644786&newsitemid=20261120067345&lan=en-US&anchor=www.braemar.q4ir.com%2Finvestor%2Ffinancials-sec-filings%2Fsec-filings%2F&index=9&md5=540a00ca2561c0a37294646c5b0c4796) .
